thesis: The site is a measured descent into the tank: scrolling takes you from grass level to the floor, and every section is a reading on the depth stick.

signature.name: depth-stick
signature.summary: Vertical ruler in left margin (desktop) or top rail (mobile) marked in inches like a sludge-judge pole; each section sits at a real tank depth (0 lid, 6 scum, 24 effluent, 40 sludge, 48 baffle, 52 floor, grade sod-back); marker slides via --sw-p. Reused in hero, process story, services, proof, prices, contact, footer.

motion.intro: Lid outline lifts 4px and lamp-yellow light falls into hero; ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Depth stick fills top-to-floor as seven process steps stamp their reading (pinned ≥640px).
Sludge-layer gauge cross-section fills scum/sludge/effluent on scroll or drag.
motion.hover: Hairline rule grows from left via scaleX under buttons and cards.
